description.value: Kam Tou Seafood Restaurant serves authentic Chinese cuisine in Richmond's Sexsmith Road area, specializing in dim sum and seafood dishes such as steamed scallop dumplings and traditional dry-fried beef ho fun. The restaurant offers online ordering through its own website for those wanting takeout. It operates within a commercial unit, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through Richmond's busy Brighouse area.
